import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePerm252
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePerm252
set_option maxRecDepth 16384
set_option maxHeartbeats 8000000
theorem zeroAndPositiveChecked : checkSite [false, false, false] (.decnz 8) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms zeroAndPositiveChecked
theorem breakChecked : checkSite [false, false, true] (.brk 1) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms breakChecked
theorem incrementChecked : checkSite [false, true, false, true, false] (.inc 8) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms incrementChecked
theorem continueChecked : checkSite [false, true, false, true, true, true] (.cont 3) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms continueChecked
theorem haltChecked : checkSite [true, true, true, false, true, false, false, true, false, true, true, false, true] (.halt) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms haltChecked
theorem overflowBreak1Checked : checkSite [true, true, true, false, true, true] (.brk 1) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms overflowBreak1Checked
theorem overflowBreak2Checked : checkSite [true, true, true, true, true, false, true, true, true] (.brk 1) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms overflowBreak2Checked
theorem overflowDecChecked : checkSite [true, true, true, true, true, true, true, true, false] (.decnz 6) = true := by decide +kernel
#print axioms overflowDecChecked
theorem invalidRegisterRejected : checkSite [false, true, false, true, false] (.inc 9) = false := by decide +kernel
theorem invalidLengthRejected : checkSite (List.replicate 41 false) .halt = false := by decide +kernel
theorem wrongLogicalRegisterRejected : checkSite [false, true, false, true, false] (.inc 7) = false := by decide +kernel
#print axioms invalidRegisterRejected
#print axioms invalidLengthRejected
#print axioms wrongLogicalRegisterRejected
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePerm252
